name: Unstable Column (3-4)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril

disable: DC 18 Crafting check (trained) to stabilize the column, DC 21 Athletics check to push the column back into place

items.name: Collapse
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps on the tiles adjacent to the column

---

Effect The column collapses. The triggering creature must attempt a DC 18 basic Reflex save save as debris falls on them, which deals 2d10+7 bludgeoning damage. The area adjacent to the collapsed column becomes difficult terrain.

text: Plaster crumbles from this column moments before it collapses.
